## Xazz v0.4.0

A governance-first release: the multi-tenant server, privacy budget, policy
guardrails, and deep-learning runtime all matured, and the public-release
gates (install, benchmark provenance, container image) were prepared.

## Highlights

- **Multi-tenant governance end to end** — per-tenant policy packs, DP budgets,
  audit history, and admin delegation (`X-Xazz-Actor`, `XAZZ_ADMIN_TOKEN`
  rotation, `XAZZ_ADMIN_ACTORS` token→actor binding) on `xazz-server`.
- **Per-query privacy cap** — opt-in `XAZZ_DP_MAX_EPSILON` fail-closed rejects a
  `withDp` ε above the cap before noise is added; enforced in the engine and at
  `POST /execute` (issue #118).
- **DL runtime** — hyperparameter sweeps (`metric`/`sort`/`top`/`tiebreak`),
  checkpoint versioning, Conv1d/Embedding (incl. per-column vocab), and
  `burn-cuda` (native CubeCL) replacing the LibTorch path (issue #62).
- **CLI surfaces** — `xazz dp budget|window|reset|reset-history`,
  `xazz policy-status`, `xazz policy-ttl`, `xazz registry undeploy`, and
  `xazz run --json` now expose DP spend/remaining, resource telemetry, and
  training/prediction diagnostics.
- **Visual IDE** — run history, audit-chain viewer, policy-pack management,
  DP budget live view, column lineage, resource telemetry, and cursor-paged
  policy/DP histories.

## Added

- DP: `XAZZ_DP_MAX_EPSILON` per-query cap; DP spend/remaining in `xazz run --json`
  (#117, #118); multi-column DP charging regression test (#119).
- Server: `GET /runs/:id/resources` resource telemetry (#128); per-tenant policy
  history, TTL, DP-window audit trails with cursor pagination; admin token
  rotation and token↔actor binding.
- CLI: DP budget/window/reset history, policy status/TTL, registry undeploy.
- DL: hyperparameter sweep sort/filter/tiebreak, MAE/R² metrics, checkpoint
  manifests, per-column Embedding vocab, ONNX export + Runtime inference (#63,
  #64).
- Ecosystem: `xazz-stdlib`, `xazz-lsp` (diagnostics/hover/goto-def/rename),
  VS Code extension, GitHub Action, policy-pack registry, Python adapter.
- Docs: `docs/SERVER.md` env reference, `docs/GPU_BACKENDS.md`,
  `docs/CONNECTORS.md`, and the mdBook documentation site.

## Changed

- **CUDA backend** — `burn-tch` (LibTorch) → `burn-cuda` (native CubeCL). Pure
  Rust; no LibTorch/system SDK/MSVC requirement (#62). *Breaking for
  `--features cuda`.*
- Dedicated retention caps for policy TTL history and DP window history.
- ONNX export scheduled to migrate to Burn 0.22 `burn-onnx`; `ort` inference
  retained. `emit rust` is now documented as a reference emitter (runtime is
  the source of truth).

## Fixed

- Security: `/execute` now completes run accounting, audit, and DP settlement
  even if the client disconnects (GHSA-wxqx-r7f6-qq3p).
- Same-tenant concurrent DP precheck/accrue is serialized (no envelope overrun).
- Sweep options without a grid (`metric:`/`sort:`/`top:`) now warn instead of
  silently doing nothing; `emit rust` VarDecl train blocks are emitted.

## Security

- **GHSA-wxqx-r7f6-qq3p** — disconnected `/execute` no longer skips run record,
  audit chain, or DP settlement. Fix is included in this release; the advisory
  `patched` range should be updated to `>= 0.4.0` after publication.

## Upgrade notes

- `--features cuda` now builds against `burn-cuda`; remove any LibTorch/tch
  setup. Runtime needs an NVIDIA driver (and, for JIT, NVRTC + CUDA headers).
- New server environment variables are documented in `docs/SERVER.md`.
- `latest` will not move for prerelease tags.

## Known limitations

- **GPU/ONNX not fully verified on real hardware** — `burn-wgpu` passed on
  Windows 11 / RTX 4070 + Intel Arc; `burn-cuda` gated parity and ONNX Runtime
  (`ort` ships `*-windows-msvc` prebuilds only) still need a suitable host.
  CPU remains the only fully verified path.
- **PyO3 native extension deferred** — `import xazz` is a CLI subprocess adapter
  (same diagnostics, boundary cost); NumPy/Pandas→Arrow handoff deferred.
- **Emitter parity incomplete** — `xazz emit rust` is a reference emitter.
- **Container image / clean-host smoke not recorded** — GHCR multi-arch images
  publish on `v*`; a smoke record for a published tag is pending (issue #176).
- **Benchmarks from a single host** — committed numbers predate provenance
  capture; `run_readme_benchmark.py` now records host metadata.
